_readme: Runtime configuration for the Photoshop AI Studio plugin.
Read by lib/bridge.js at startup. Editable while the plugin is loaded:
UXP Developer Tool reloads the plugin when the file changes.
Values must match the MCP server's PLUGIN_PORT and WORKSPACE_ROOT (see
_workspaceRoot: Photoshop-side filesystem allowlist. The MCP server already validates every
path against its own WORKSPACE_ROOT; this is the independent second check
that runs inside Photoshop. A path must be inside BOTH to be usable.
Absolute POSIX or Windows path, e.g. /Users/you/ps-ai-studio/workspace
_outputDir: Where export_png / export_jpg / save_psd write when no path is given.
